head: 42cd7fad8f82a1de069219062fb0a90432fb6809
claim: A refresh finishes when Herdr refuses a pane's status watch with its own probe id, and a bootstrap that parks keeps a bounded backlog instead of a growing one

verdicts.seen: I read all 5 entries. The probe entry shows 'refresh settled in 1 ms' after 'herdr: status subscription rejected: pane_not_found: pane w1:p2 not found', so the refresh finishes on Herdr's rejection of a pane's status watch. The buffer entry shows 'the bootstrap buffer hit its cap (513 events, 61853 bytes held)' and says the tree is re-read, which shows the backlog is bounded. The 'stopped: ready settled in 0 ms: false' and 'refresh settled in 478 ms, snapshotCount 1 -> 2' entries don't contradict the outcome. The outcome names no separate widths, themes or frames, so parts is empty. The one soft point is whether w1:p2 counts as the refresh's 'own probe id'.
